text: natalie: FYI rolling v2-smallint8 to 10% canary now. latency looks good but we're seeing a small MRR dip on the docs benchmark (~2.8%). keeping an eye. infra-bot: deploy started for model=v2-smallint8, target_slice=10%, run_id=canary-4398765432 :rocket: natalie: quick ask — before we auto-fallback, can we tighten the gating logic? current rule is a single-window MRR delta > 2% triggers fallback which seems noisy for longdocs. dave: can you paste the early numbers? what slice, sample size? natalie: slice=docs-longform, sample_n=6k requests over 20m, mrr_control=0.487, mrr_canary=0.474, absolute drop=0.013 (~2.67%). hallucination rate unchanged. alex_ryan: suggestion — require a concordance-style metric in addition to MRR. a per-request concordance (CPR) between reference outputs and canary outputs; I think that flags semantic regressions that MRR alone misses. smita: i like CPR. what's a practical threshold? alex_ryan: thinking CPR is fraction of requests where top-1 match of normalized entities/ids or key snippets overlap >= 0.7. on our docs eval that maps well to user-visible regressions. kevin: operationally we should require both: (a) relative MRR drop >= 3% OR (b) MRR drop >= 2% AND CPR delta <= -0.02 (i.e., concordance fell by more than 0.02). and require the signal to persist for two consecutive 15m windows before autofallback. natalie: that hybrid rule seems reasonable — avoids flapping on minor stat noise but catches semantic loss. smita: also add min_sample_size=2000 per window and require both metrics to be computed on same request slices. infra-bot: canary telemetry: window1(0-15m) mrr_delta=-2.7%, cpr_delta=-0.018, n=3200; window2(15-30m) mrr_delta=-2.9%, cpr_delta=-0.021, n=2800. infra-bot: alert triggered: meets hybrid rule (mrr drop >=2% + cpr_delta<=-0.02 in consecutive windows) natalie: ok looks like it just crossed. I'm going to pause promotion and flip to 0% while we dig in. quick config snippet for the gate I'll push to rollout config: ```json { "gate_type": "hybrid_mrr_cpr", "mrr_rel_threshold": 0.02, "mrr_or_rel_threshold": 0.03, "cpr_delta_threshold": -0.02, "consecutive_windows": 2, "window_minutes": 15, "min_samples_per_window": 2000, "action_on_trigger": "auto_fallback" } ``` dave: nice. can we also log the testcase ids for failing requests and dump kv-cache mismatch counts to S3? natalie: yes — adding a debug dump for the next 2h to s3://redwood-debug/canary-4398765432/ kevin: after rollback let's run a 1-hour shadow run with v2-smallint8 on a sampled cohort and run the CPR sensitivity test (vary tokenization and entity normalization). alex_ryan: noted — I'll add a lightweight CPR implementation to the eval harness and a notebook for explainability. smita: tagging @ops for follow-up runbook updates. natalie: thanks all. action items: natalie pause promotion + dump logs; alex add CPR to harness; dave enable kv dumps; kevin run 1h shadow once root cause triage done. :white_check_mark:
